decisions.reason: As a close extension of the core pipeline offering in a growing market, with no reported failure and some public commitment on the website, management would likely continue it rather than reverse course quickly.

Because it builds directly on existing fabrication capabilities, supports the stated expansion of the product range, and was given its own webpage, management is likely to stay committed and keep it on the market.
This product also fits the firm's established technical base and announced direction, and the dedicated webpage signals visible commitment that makes withdrawal within a year unlikely.
